profile.name: Claim
profile.description: Claims MiniMax Daily Check-in credits on the signed-in box browser each morning. Quiet when already claimed; notifies the desk only when credits land or login expired.

memory.content: This bot needs a signed-in session in the box browser at https://agent.minimax.io before the daily check-in can claim credits. Never type passwords; if login expired, hand the box to the user via the desk.

routines.name: MiniMax daily check-in
routines.description: Fires daily at 8:03 local (including weekends) to claim MiniMax Daily Check-in credits.
routines.content:
Every day at 8:03 local including weekends (MiniMax credits reset daily). Claim the MiniMax Daily Check-in on the signed-in box browser at https://agent.minimax.io. Session should already be signed in with an active plan. Path: bottom-left profile chip, then Daily Check-in (gift icon). A 7-day rewards modal opens; click today's claim. Stay silent if already claimed or nothing changed. Notify the desk coordinator only when credits were actually collected, or when login has expired — then the desk hands the user the box; do not type passwords. Do not generate songs, spend credits, start tasks, or change settings.

Fires on:
- cron `3 8 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
